verdict.line: You lose if you walk into Q (Corrosive Charge) poke before 6 and get chunked down; you win if you track Disdain's cooldown and time E (Hookshot) or R (The Hextech Ultimatum) onto him when it's gone.

brief.thesis: This is a measured 48.5% win rate over 978 games, functionally even, but the shape is lopsided: Urgot's Q (Corrosive Charge) at 800 range outpokes Camille's 325/610/800 kit before level 6, and his E (Disdain) at 475 range gives him a free poke-and-reset tool she can't punish on cooldown reads alone. Camille's answer is her mobility — E (Hookshot) off a wall and R anchoring him in place — which only works once Disdain is down. The solo-kill stat favoring Urgot is a direct product of that poke-then-Disdain-away pattern.

theirWindow.when: Disdain is up and you're in its 475 range
theirWindow.what: He can poke with Q (Corrosive Charge, 800 range, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s cooldown) and then dash away with Disdain if you try to punish, or use it to trample forward and throw you out of position. Don't commit your E (Hookshot) engage into a live Disdain — he'll just stop you mid-animation and hurl you back.

yourWindow.what: This is your all-in window. Use E (Hookshot) from a nearby wall to close the gap he can't counter, or walk him into R (The Hextech Ultimatum) range at 475 — once anchored, your basic attacks deal bonus magic damage to him and he physically cannot Disdain out.

start.why: Measured as the stronger start into this matchup (50.4% over 561 games) — the passive block and regen directly offset Urgot's Q (Corrosive Charge) poke chipping you down before you can close distance.

boots.why: Taken in 84.5% of games at a 50.6% win rate — Urgot's damage is entirely physical, from his basic attacks, Passive (Echoing Flames) procs, and Q, so flat armor reduces every source he has.

core.why: The highest-measured core path starts here (54.3% win rate over 243 games) — the move speed and burst proc are what let you actually close the gap Urgot's poke opens up.
Sustain and cleave to win extended trades once you're in his face, matching the measured build path.

runes.keystoneWhy: The higher-pick-rate page (21.1% pick, 50.8% win rate) runs this — sustained healing from auto-attacking him in melee range is exactly what offsets being out-ranged by Q (Corrosive Charge) before 6.

summoners.why: The most-picked combo (63.5% pick rate) — Flash backs up your E (Hookshot) engage timing, and Ignite secures kills during your all-in window before Urgot can Disdain away, directly countering his measured solo-kill edge.

playing.title: Soak Q pokes behind minions
playing.detail: Corrosive Charge is 800 range and explodes on impact — stand behind your casters early so the wave eats the poke instead of you.

playing.title: Never dive into live Disdain
playing.detail: If his E (Disdain, 475 range) is up, any engage gets stopped and thrown back out. Wait for the 16-14s cooldown to run out first.

playing.title: Trade with W's outer edge
playing.detail: Tactical Sweep's outer half slows and deals extra damage while healing you — land the edge, not the center, to control the follow-up trade.

playing.title: Hold E for the wall, not the gap-close
playing.detail: Hookshot requires a wall to leap off — pre-position near terrain so you can threaten the engage the moment Disdain is down.

playing.title: Bait during his Purge animation
playing.detail: W (Purge) slows Urgot while it's active — if you can walk out of its 490 range and bait the cast, you get a free window to close in afterward.

playing.title: Anchor him with R the instant he commits
playing.detail: The Hextech Ultimatum stops him from using Disdain to escape once it lands — save it specifically for the moment he tries to walk away from a losing trade.

playing.title: Play around his execute past level 6
playing.detail: Fear Beyond Death hits from 2500 range and can execute you below its threshold — don't overextend on low health even outside his melee range.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners and all win-rate figures above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are this brief's own analysis, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Urgot’s (Q) pokes and his (E)-(R) combo after he reaches level 6! Avoid Urgot’s ultimate with Camille’s ultimate to easily win the fight!
